implementationSummary: Added an adapter-owned runtime session store for SDK session id to Codex runtime conversation identity mappings.
Persisted records store sdkSessionId, runtimeSessionId, codexThreadId, cwd, model, toolFingerprint, codexHomeIdentity, createdAt, and updatedAt.
session.create writes the mapping after Codex thread/start returns a thread id.
session.resume falls back to the persisted mapping when the adapter in-memory sessions map is empty, then calls Codex thread/resume for the mapped thread id.
session.delete removes the persisted mapping after successful Codex thread/archive.
semanticBoundary: The store persists the adapter mapping, not the full conversation transcript.
Codex remains the runtime truth for the conversation rollout/thread record.
Cross-process restart continuity requires both a stable runtime session store path and a stable Codex home/runtime storage identity.

Full SDK-visible history reconstruction after adapter restart is not claimed by this brick; it remains a fidelity follow-up if product paths require getMessages() to replay pre-restart SDK event shape.

restartSimulation.description: A first adapter instance creates a session and writes the store; a second adapter instance with an empty in-memory sessions map and the same store resumes the SDK session by calling Codex thread/resume instead of thread/start.

residualRisks: If the adapter uses isolated temporary Codex homes, a persisted SDK-to-thread mapping alone is insufficient for process-restart continuity because Codex rollout storage identity also changes.
Tool-set compatibility on resume is still a separate Phase 4 policy brick.
Pre-restart SDK event history replay through session.getMessages() is not reconstructed from Codex thread/read in this brick.
